rooms.name: Inside the Stadium
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a large stadium. To the north, you see some doors
that can only lead to the field. Up from here is the stands. To the south,
you can see the entrance to the stadium.

rooms.name: The Entrance to the Stadium
rooms.desc:
You are at the entrance to a large stadium. The roar of the crowd inside is
deafening. Obviously, there are a LOT of people in there enjoying themselves.
To the north, you can continue further into the stadium. To the south, you
can see the Avenue of the Gods. There is a SIGN tacked up over the entrance,
written in crude common.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside the doors of the arena, which lie to the south. Bits
of broken weapons and bones line the ground, and the sparse grass that grows
here is stained with old blood. Spectators line the seats above you in the
stands.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the blood-stained grass of the arena. Fans above you shout
and scream; some for you, some against. The sounds of battle come from all 
around. The exit lies to the west.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
The arena field under your feet is pitted and rough. The smell of blood fills
your nose just as the screams of the spectators fills your ears. The rage of
battle boils in your blood.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
The doors to the southwest seem very far away across the battle-torn field.
Above you, fans shout for you to press your attack.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
Far to the southwest you see the doors of the arena. Around you rise the
stands on which shouting fans revel, and on the field before you a managerie
of assorted monsters seek your blood.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the southeastern corner of a wide arena. The noise coming
at you from all directions is deafening. The crowd, the battles... it's enough
to make you feel a bit overwhelmed.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
The stench of death fills your nose and your eyes glaze over with the thick
haze covering the arena. The spectators in the stands above you shout loudly
for blood.
